title: digest_validator
description: Digest projection of a Python validator/generation module. Captures exported functions, error/warning codes emitted, and schema path references for coverage and drift analysis.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a validator digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root (e.g. tools/specdev_tools/validation/hallucination_lint.py).

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

module_path.description: Python module dotted path derived from the file path (e.g. tools.specdev_tools.validation.hallucination_lint).

error_codes.description: E-codes (e.g. E530, E110) emitted via make_error() calls in this module. Extracted from AST literals.

warning_codes.description: W-codes (e.g. W570) emitted via make_error() calls in this module.

checks_exported.description: Public function names (not prefixed with _) defined at module top-level. These are the callable check entry points.

guide_refs.description: Guide code strings found as string literals in this module (e.g. E110-UNKNOWN_CANONICAL_ID). Indicates which error codes have associated guide documentation.

schema_paths_referenced.description: Schema file path strings referenced inside this module (e.g. relative .schema.json path strings found in literals).

imports.description: Top-level import module names (first component only, e.g. json, os, re). Useful for dependency drift detection.
